name: Sana Sakakibara
source: The smallest and quietest girl in Sensei's class, sitting in the back. She is very shy, letting her roommate and friend Ayane take the lead in most social situations, and typically wears her hair such that it conceals much of her face. She can be found working at the bar at night.
